evidence: The project-creation path still requires a scholarly objective and one exact workflow profile, and the native Windows vertical plus complete service and desktop suites pass unchanged.

Every projected default value is now part of one Core guidance document with version 1.0.0 and canonical SHA-256 2feffbaf216da3adb4d8fe0b3ca6e2579cdc2dcedc2d57341086a14def5fe0d2. The generated client requires that identity and the desktop owns no parallel values table.

CAP-03.S06.T02-R01-F01 is remediated by an immutable workflow.profile.activated provenance event created atomically with the first binding and selection. The binding names the witness event and hashes its exact bytes; the witness independently binds the actor, time, and binding digest. Combined deletion of both the settings binding and every workflow-profile row leaves the witness and fails closed after restart.

Deleting or substituting the independent witness while settings authority remains also fails closed. Exact pre-T02 schema-v10 bytes still have neither binding nor witness, upgrade once without predecessor rewrite, survive restart, and replay idempotently.
The already closed CAP-03.S06.T02-R01-F02 remains fixed: exact retained, removed, and added autonomy and stopping effects pass service and assembled-browser replay before acknowledgement.

CAP-03.S06.T02-R01-F03 is remediated by separating workflow-profile identity from intent-guidance identity. The projection advertises both exact hashes, the activation binding carries both, the generated decoder rejects substitution, and a one-value guidance mutation changes the guidance hash while leaving the profile catalog identity semantically distinct.

UI evidence now calls the defaults separately versioned and content-hash-bound Core guidance rather than catalog-authored. Native stale-state claims remain narrowed to the actual boundary, and all-tools, evidence, provenance, policy, human authority, idempotency, and immutable history behavior remain green.

verificationSelection.riskAnalysis: Mandatory R03 replay centers on CAP-03.S06.T02-R01-F01 and CAP-03.S06.T02-R01-F03. CAP-03.S06.T02-R01-F01 recurred because R02 tested activation and selection loss separately while co-locating both in settings; R03 therefore tests combined settings loss, an independently surviving provenance witness, witness deletion/substitution, atomic publication, restart, exact predecessor upgrade, and native protected-SQLite inspection. CAP-03.S06.T02-R01-F03 recurred because R02 treated Core location as governance without hashing the values; R03 therefore checks exact guidance hash recomputation, one-value mutation, generated client substitution denial, activation binding, UI evidence wording, and renderer use of the single projection. Full service/contracts/data/desktop suites, protected storage, native integration, static checks, architecture, UI gate, planning integrity, and exact-range hygiene cover the incremental shared-boundary risk. Performance is unchanged and retained for W1 exit.
deferred: Desktop and data performance commands are gate-bound to W1 exit; R03 changes no performance budget or algorithmic workflow path.

Complete cross-capability failure, denial, cancellation, migration, restart, recovery, security, accessibility, packaging, performance, primary-platform, and visual qualification remains mandatory at CAP-03.S06 slice review, integration checkpoints, and W1 exit.

reviewerDisposition.rootCauseAnalysis: R01-F01 recurred because the R02 implementation treated a different settings key as independent authority and tested activation and selection deletion separately; both still vanished under one settings-ledger deletion. R01-F03 recurred because the R02 implementation treated physical centralization in Core plus key-set equality as governed value identity; it never enumerated or hashed the new guidance values. The shared root cause was substituting location and presence checks for explicit value-bearing identity plus an independent survivor invariant. R03 corrects both systemically: the first binding is witnessed in the separate immutable provenance ledger and every guidance value is covered by its own versioned canonical hash across Core, activation, generated client, desktop, tests, and evidence. Preventive tests combine settings loss, delete or substitute the witness, mutate one guidance value, and reject a substituted generated-client hash.
